The Lead AI/ML Engineer is a primary driver in the design and development of state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence solutions with a strong focus on Natural Language Processing (NLP), Transformer-based architectures, Vector Database technologies, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The Lead AI/ML Engineer works closely with senior data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and subject matter experts on current company technologies and forward-looking projects. They drive research, innovation, and solution implementation in the creation of next-generation AI systems.

Key Responsibilities
· Lead end-to-end training and fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), including both open-source (e.g., Qwen, LLaMA, Mistral) and closed-source (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) ecosystems.
· Deep knowledge and extensive experience with Machine/Deep Learning frameworks including transformer architectures, state space models, large language models, and agentic approaches.
· Architect and implement GraphRAG pipelines, including knowledge graph representation and retrieval for enhanced contextual grounding.
· Design, train, and optimize semantic and dense vector embeddings for document understanding, search, and retrieval.
· Develop semantic retrieval systems with advanced document segmentation and indexing strategies.
· Knowledge of algorithms and techniques within a computational domain with emphasis on text processing.
This keeps the JD exactly as is while making it immediately obvious that the role's primary focus is NLP, Transformers, Vector Databases, Embeddings, Retrieval, and RAG.

Preferred Qualifications
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
• 11-15+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied AI/ML, and Statistical Modeling, with a strong track record of developing, deploying, and scaling production-grade AI solutions.
Deep expertise in:
• Natural Language Processing (NLP)
• Fundamental Machine Learning
• Deep Learning
• Transformer Architectures
• State Space-Based Architectures
• Azure ML and/or AWS
• Strong Python programming, SQL, database querying, data preparation, and analysis skills
• Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
• Experience with PyTorch
• LLM training and fine-tuning (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen)
• Graph-based retrieval systems (Knowledge Graphs)
• Embedding models (e.g., BGE, E5, SimCSE)
• Semantic Search and Vector Databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Milvus)
• Model Fusion and Ensemble Techniques (Stacking, Boosting, Gating)
• Optimization Algorithms (Bayesian, Particle Swarm, Genetic Algorithms)
• Reinforcement Learning (e.g., RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO), Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), LoRA, QLoRA, Axolotl
• Prompt Optimization Frameworks (AutoPrompt, GreaterPrompt, DSPy), GEPA
Key focus areas: NLP, Transformer-Based Architectures, Vector Database Technologies, Semantic Search, Embedding Models, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

About Us

HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation, Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.

Job Summary 

Responsible for driving the overarching organic search strategy to increase high-intent traffic, enhance search visibility, and directly contribute to the company's revenue pipeline. By balancing technical site health, intent-driven content creation, and international localization, this role ensures our global web presence captures and converts prospective buyers. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven person who seamlessly translates complex search algorithms into actionable business growth while partnering effectively across marketing, web, and regional teams. 
                                        
Key Responsibilities

Own and execute the global SEO strategy across corporate, product, solution, industry, resource, and regional websites to increase qualified organic traffic, search visibility, and pipeline contribution.          
Lead technical SEO audits and partner with the Web Manager, developers, and external agencies to resolve issues related to crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, redirects, canonicalization, internal linking, and site performance.                                        
Develop and execute backlink and authority-building strategies, including competitor backlink analysis, digital PR opportunities, outreach campaigns, and link acquisition initiatives.                                    
Conduct keyword research and build SEO content strategies for product pages, solution pages, blogs, comparison pages, glossary pages, and topic clusters in partnership with Product Marketing and Content teams.
Support international SEO initiatives by optimizing localized websites through regional keyword research, hreflang implementation, metadata optimization, and localization best practices.
Monitor SEO performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, and other SEO platforms; translate insights into actionable recommendations and business impact.    
Collaborate closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Web Development, Analytics, Regional Marketing, and external agencies to align SEO initiatives with campaign goals and revenue objectives.
Own SEO reporting across rankings, organic traffic, conversions, MQLs, pipeline influence, and competitive performance while providing regular updates and strategic recommendations to leadership 

Skills & Experience Needed

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
4–5 years of progressive SEO experience in a B2B SaaS company, with demonstrated ownership of technical SEO and organic growth initiatives.
Strong expertise in Technical SEO, including website audits, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, international SEO, and website migrations.
Hands-on experience with SEO tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to translate SEO insights into measurable business outcomes.

About us

Build the future of banking.
Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 
 
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
 
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
 …and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
 
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
 
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
 
 
About the role
This role is designed for someone early in their Rewards career who wants to build deep expertise across compensation, benefits, and Rewards communications. You will work closely with the Rewards Partner to support the design, execution, and communication of Total Rewards programs across the organization. You will be the conduit between strategy and execution — owning communication, enabling change, conducting market research, and supporting large Rewards projects. 


Responsibilities
• 

Own the end-to-end communication strategy for all Rewards programs — including compensation cycles, benefits launches and initiatives, policy updates, and wellness initiatives

• 

Build communication toolkits, FAQs, presentation decks, manager guides, and explainer materials to drive awareness and understanding of Rewards programs

• 

Translate complex Rewards frameworks, pay philosophies, and policy changes into simple, engaging, and accessible content for employees, managers, and leadership

• 

Partner with People Success and Internal Comms teams to ensure timely, consistent, and impactful delivery of Rewards messaging across all channels

• 

Support change management planning for any major Rewards transformation (e.g., new comp structures, benefits redesign, appraisal process changes) — including stakeholder mapping, impact assessments, and rollout plans

• 

Gather employee and manager feedback post-communication to assess effectiveness and continuously improve messaging strategies

• 

Conduct ongoing market research and competitive benchmarking across compensation, benefits, and wellness practices — with a focus on tech, fintech, and enterpise and solutioning sector

• 

Support the Rewards Partner in annual and ad hoc salary benchmarking exercises using survey data (e.g., Radford, Mercer, Korn Ferry)

• 

Track industry trends in total rewards, variable pay, equity, and benefits — synthesizing insights into actionable briefs for the Rewards team and leadership

• 

Build and maintain a research repository covering pay trends, competitor benefits practices, and regulatory updates across India, the US, and UAE

• 

Analyze internal compensation data to identify patterns, anomalies, and equity gaps, and present findings with clear narrative and recommendations

Skills
• 

Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to simplify complex topics and tailor messaging for different audiences (employees, managers, executives)

• 

Foundational understanding of compensation and benefits concepts — pay structures, benchmarking, variable pay, wellness programs

• 

Analytical mindset with comfort working in Excel/Google Sheets; exposure to HR analytics tools is a plus

• 

Organized and detail-oriented — able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

• 

Collaborative team player with a proactive attitude and eagerness to learn

• 

Change management awareness — understanding of how to help people navigate organizational or program changes

• 

Curiosity and innovation — you look at what others are doing and constantly ask "how can we do this better?

• 

Ability to document, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• 

High integrity and trustworthiness — ability to handle sensitive data with discretion and confidentiality.

Experience and Qualifications
• Graduate/ Post Graduate or MBA in HR

• 

2–3 years of relevant experience in Rewards, Compensation & Benefits, or Total Rewards is preferred.

• 

Hands-on exposure to HRIS, compensation benchmarking/survey platforms, and HR analytics tools is an added advantage.

• 

Experience or academic exposure to project management, stakeholder communications, or change management is a strong plus.

• 

Prior experience in the Technology, FinTech, SaaS, or BFSI industry is preferred, though candidates from other industries with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
